name: Test LSP Contribution (fixture)
description: Fixture plugin that demonstrates the Phase B LSP contribution pathway (manifest.lspServers + lsp-registry). Ships a single echo-style LSP that responds to initialize, textDocument/completion, hover, and publishDiagnostics — sourced from the same in-process fixture the sidecar tests use. Use this when verifying the end-to-end Skills/Canvas/Artifact LSP plumbing without needing to install a real .vsix.
author: cognia-next

initializationOptions.note: Fixture only. Real plugin contributions should supply absolute paths or relative paths that anchor against the plugin install directory.

browser.reason: LSP servers spawn through the Node sidecar — desktop only.

tauri.reason: Plugin manager registers the echo LSP through lib/plugin/lsp/lsp-registry on enable; the sidecar's CogniaLspClient spawns the fixture as a child process.
